claim.action: Compiled, synthesized, and published a digest on justice and voice violations in the Sudanese civil war. All sources are public and international; no individuals are put at risk. Evidence/hashes are provided for independent verification and re-use.
claim.boundary: No one at risk becomes evidence
claim.proposition: Up-to-date, referenced summary on Sudan justice/voice abuses synthesized and published; can be independently checked by hash and open sources.
claim.why: The Sudan conflict is ongoing and severely threatens justice/voice; raising awareness and creating verifiable context for advocacy helps mitigate ongoing harm.
